question: Can the 1988 Candaba aquatic-fauna thesis provide reusable species-level fish evidence through currently available records?

source.citation: Habito, C. V. (1988). Survey of the taxonomic fauna of Candaba Swamp, Pampanga. Master's thesis, University of the Philippines Los Baños.
source.accessNote: The official UPLB repository says the document is not available online and lists the UPLB Main Library Special Collections Section (USCS), call number LG 995 1988 Z62 H33. AGRIS identifies UPLB as the provider of its bibliographic record. No thesis scan or digital full text was retrieved.

catalogReportedScope.taxonResolutionLimit: The available catalog abstract provides family names and counts but no individual fish species names. Preserve the spellings exactly as cataloged; do not silently normalize family names or infer binomials.

interpretationAndRights.timeAndPlaceLimit: The reported survey season is historical study scope, not a dated collection record for each of the eight fish labels. The abstract does not identify sampling stations, precise waterbody reaches, coordinates, or the scope of either map.
interpretationAndRights.reuse: No thesis-specific reuse license or permission was verified. The catalog record is not permission to reproduce the thesis, maps, illustrations, or tables.
interpretationAndRights.decision: Metadata and abstract support a historical richness/family lead only. They do not support individual species assertions, current presence, a complete Candaba checklist, or geometry.

alternativeAccessRoute.route: Physical-library holding recorded by the official UPLB repository: UPLB Main Library Special Collections Section (USCS), call number LG 995 1988 Z62 H33.
alternativeAccessRoute.limitation: Current library access, reproduction, and thesis-copy policies were not checked. Confirm those rules before planning an on-site visit or requesting reproduction.

nextAction: If the library copy can be consulted under its access rules, review the fish descriptions, species names, sampling stations, dates, voucher/deposit notes, maps, and reproduction terms independently. Until then retain only the attributed abstract-level counts and family strings.

sources.supports: Official thesis title, author, date, degree, physical library location, call number, and statement that the document is unavailable from the repository.
UPLB-provided catalog abstract, 1987 survey period, 59 total aquatic animal species, eight freshwater fish species/families, family names as printed, and thesis extent.
